observed: count_words counts more words than a file has when it has double spaces or line breaks, and top_words can report an empty string as a top word.
reproduction:
count_words('one   two
three
') returns 4, not 3; top_words('a   b

a', 1) returns [('', 2)], not [('a', 2)].
root_cause: words() splits on a single space character, so repeated spaces produce empty strings and newlines stay inside tokens; empty strings are then counted as words.
invariant: A word is a non-empty token between runs of whitespace; counts and rankings never include empty strings.
fix: Split on any whitespace and drop empty tokens after stripping punctuation.
